newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Oil Search to accept Premier offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Oil Search to accept Premier offer.

text.p: Oil Search Ltd said on Monday it would accept Premier Oil Plc's increased 81 cent a share takeover offer for its stake in Discovery Petroleum NL.
Oil Search managing director Peter Botten said the company had carried out a detailed and technical review of Discovery.
However, he believed that "further investment in the company, at the required prices, would not deliver sufficient material returns to Oil Search shareholders in the medium term".
Oil Search is the largest shareholder in Discovery with a 10.1 percent stake which was aquired in late September at 75 cents a share when Premier's bid was only 70 cents.
The directors of Discovery earlier on Monday recommended Premier's increased offer to 81 cents from 80 cents a share.
Premier said that following Discovery's recommendation it expected its entitlement to rise to about 13 percent.
Discovery had previously rejected Premier's previous two offers. The new bid values Discovery at about A$105.50 million.
Premier said its offer had been extended until the end of trade on December 16. It said its offer was now conditional only upon minimum acceptances of 50.1 percent.
The sharemarket had been expecting a rival bid for Discovery to emerge from Oil Search.
Botten said Oil Search had maintained its disciplined approach to investment of shareholders' capital.
Oil Search would continue to concentrate on appraising and developing its new Moran oil discovery in the Papua New Guinea Highlands, he said.
